## Source
.design/m5/45-ml-classifier.md — REQ-6, AC-3 + decomposition PR 5.

## Surface
- Extend `polaris-frontend/src/components/network_panel.rs` (just shipped in #97) OR a new sibling `classifier_panel.rs` to surface `ClassifierSignal` observations.
- Extend the case-view DTO with classifier observations.
- UI: side-by-side display per Q5-A.

## Rust-quality notes
- **Reuse the existing observation-list rendering pattern** — the case view already renders `Observation` rows; classifier observations are just another `ObservationKind` variant. Per rust-quality §9: don't fork the renderer.
- **Disagreement detection is server-side**: when materializing classifier signals (#127), if two classifiers return different labels for the same `event_cid`, both rows exist. The frontend just renders both.
- **Per rust-quality §2**: a `ClassifierObservationGroup { event_cid, observations: Vec<ClassifierObservation> }` newtype to group by event before render — the grouping is data-shape, the rendering is presentation.
- **Cloud-API transparency banner**: when ANY observation in the group came from a classifier marked `external = true` (Q2-C provisional), surface a banner: "this case was scored by external classifier <name>" with the operator's privacy-disclosure text.
- Per rust-quality §3 (frontend equivalent): the panel takes `observations: &[ClassifierObservation]` by reference. Returns `impl IntoView`.

## External references
- v1 observation rendering pattern in-repo: `polaris-frontend/src/components/network_panel.rs` (from #97)
- Leptos signals / reactive patterns: https://book.leptos.dev/view/03_components.html

## Acceptance (AC-3)
- [ ] Two fixture classifiers return opposite labels for the same event. The case view renders both with classifier names visible.
- [ ] External-classifier banner appears when any contributing classifier is marked `external = true`.
- [ ] styles_coverage test passes for the new BEM classes.

## Blocks / blocked-by
- Blocked by #128.
- Blocks #130 (feedback path needs the UI surface).
